To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the macroevolutionary trajectories of morphological integration do not correlate with the macroevolution of morphological disparity.
“The relationship between morphological disparity and morphological integration is not straightforward.

1) there is not a general relationship between morphological disparity and overall morphological integration in the crinoid lineage; 2) there is a significant change in integration patterns between Palaeozoic (more homogeneous integration patterns) and post-Palæozoic (more heterogeneous integration patterns) crinoids; 3) the observed changes in integration patterns can explain the observed differences in disparity dynamics between the two groups.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between morphospace and morphospace.
the relationship between morphologic integration and morphologic disparity.
the evolutionary consequences of morphological integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
morphological integration and disparity are not related to each other.
morphological integration is a necessary but not sufficient condition for the generation of morphological disparity.

the macroevolutionary trajectory of morphological disparity is related not to the overall degree of integration but rather to the way it is distributed among traits and to the way it changes in the course of evolution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the evolutionary history of crinoideans is a story of modularity, not of individual traits.
morphological disparity does not seem to depend on the overall degree, but rather on the distributional patterns of integration.
morphological disparity dynamics are more likely to be constrained by reorganization of the modularity structure of the phenotype than by the variability of individual phenotypic traits.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, to understand the evolutionary dynamics of morphological diversity, we need a better understanding of how morphological integration and disparity covary.
the macroevolutionary trajectories of morphological integration can be more informative about the dynamics of morphospace than the overall degree of integration.

, in order to understand the macroevolutionary dynamics of morphological diversity, it is necessary to go beyond simple descriptions of the variability of traits and to consider the organization of the phenotypes.
